resolvedFindings.origin: root diagnostic; independently inspected final replacement images

renderedImageReview.scope: All 119 C views at both 320 and 1280 CSS px. Real textbook page with the in-review preview enabled, not a replacement SVG harness.
renderedImageReview.duplicatePolicy: Only byte-identical PNG SHA-256 values share review; every unique final PNG hash is either directly inspected or matched to a previously inspected image. No transfer by filename, task number or visual similarity.

actualPageContext.method: Fresh isolated browser contexts. Open each card through the real app, capture initial full page, click the help and every next-step button, expand each step explanation, then capture last full page. No local pupil answers were inserted.
actualPageContext.inspection: All 16 tasks had initial/last mobile/desktop top overviews inspected.
